ability_improvement.name: Ability Improvement
ability_improvement.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1, up to a maximum of 20.
benefits: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1, up to a maximum of 20.

actor.name: Actor
actor.description: Your Charisma ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
benefits: Your Charisma ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

alert.name: Alert
alert.description: You gain a +5 bonus to initiative and can't be Surprised .
benefits: You gain a +5 bonus to initiative and can't be Surprised .

athlete.name: Athlete
athlete.description:
Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you are Prone , standing up uses significantly less movement.
benefits: Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you are Prone , standing up uses significantly less movement.

charger.name: Charger
charger.description: Charge forward and slam your weapon into the first enemy in your way without provoking Opportunity Attacks .
benefits: Charge forward and slam your weapon into the first enemy in your way without provoking Opportunity Attacks .

crossbow_expert.name: Crossbow Expert
crossbow_expert.description: When you make crossbow attacks within melee range, the attack rolls do not have Disadvantage .
benefits: When you make crossbow attacks within melee range, the attack rolls do not have Disadvantage .

defensive_duellist.name: Defensive Duellist
defensive_duellist.description: When you are attacked with a melee attack while wielding a Finesse weapon you are proficient in, you can use a Reaction to increase your Armour Class by your proficiency bonus, possibly causing the attack to miss. Requires Dexterity to be at least 13.
benefits: When you are attacked with a melee attack while wielding a Finesse weapon you are proficient in, you can use a Reaction to increase your Armour Class by your proficiency bonus, possibly causing the attack to miss. Requires Dexterity to be at least 13.

dual_wielder.name: Dual Wielder
dual_wielder.description: You can use Two-Weapon Fighting even if your weapons aren't Light .
benefits: You can use Two-Weapon Fighting even if your weapons aren't Light .

dungeon_delver.name: Dungeon Delver
dungeon_delver.description: You gain Advantage on Perception checks made to detect hidden objects and on Saving throws made to avoid or resist traps.
benefits: You gain Advantage on Perception checks made to detect hidden objects and on Saving throws made to avoid or resist traps.

durable.name: Durable
durable.description: Your Constitution ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
benefits: Your Constitution ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

elemental_adept.name: Elemental Adept
elemental_adept.description:
Your spells and attacks ignore resistance to a damage type of your choice. In addition, when you deal that type of damage with a spell , you cannot roll a 1.
Damage resistance options are one of the following: Elemental Adept: Acid
Elemental Adept: Cold
Elemental Adept: Lightning
Elemental Adept: Fire
benefits: Your spells and attacks ignore resistance to a damage type of your choice. In addition, when you deal that type of damage with a spell , you cannot roll a 1.
Damage resistance options are one of the following: Elemental Adept: Acid
Elemental Adept: Cold
Elemental Adept: Lightning
Elemental Adept: Fire

great_weapon_master.name: Great Weapon Master
great_weapon_master.description: When an attack with a melee weapon lands a Critical Hit or kills a creature, you can make another melee weapon attack as a Bonus Action that turn.
benefits: When an attack with a melee weapon lands a Critical Hit or kills a creature, you can make another melee weapon attack as a Bonus Action that turn.

heavily_armoured.name: Heavily Armoured

benefits: Your Strength ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

benefits: Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.description: You gain 3 Luck Points that recharge after a Long Rest , which you can use to gain Advantage on Attack rolls , Ability checks , or Saving throws , or to make an enemy reroll their Attack roll .
benefits: You gain 3 Luck Points that recharge after a Long Rest , which you can use to gain Advantage on Attack rolls , Ability checks , or Saving throws , or to make an enemy reroll their Attack roll .

mage_slayer.name: Mage Slayer
mage_slayer.description: When a creature casts a Spell within melee range of you, you have Advantage on any Saving throws against it.
benefits: When a creature casts a Spell within melee range of you, you have Advantage on any Saving throws against it.

magic_initiate_bard.name: Magic Initiate: Bard
magic_initiate_bard.description: Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Bard spell list . You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest . Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Charisma .
benefits: Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Bard spell list . You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest . Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Charisma .

martial_adept.name: Martial Adept
martial_adept.description: Learn two Manoeuvres from the Battle Master archetype and receive 1 (additional) Superiority Die to fuel them. You regain expended Superiority Dice after a Short or Long Rest .
benefits: Learn two Manoeuvres from the Battle Master archetype and receive 1 (additional) Superiority Die to fuel them. You regain expended Superiority Dice after a Short or Long Rest .

medium_armour_master.name: Medium Armour Master
medium_armour_master.description: When you wear medium armour, it doesn't impose Disadvantage on Stealth checks. The bonus to Armour Class you can gain from your Dexterity modifier also becomes +3 instead of +2.
benefits: When you wear medium armour, it doesn't impose Disadvantage on Stealth checks. The bonus to Armour Class you can gain from your Dexterity modifier also becomes +3 instead of +2.

polearm_master.name: Polearm Master
polearm_master.description: When attacking with a Glaive , Halberd , Pike , Quarterstaff , or Spear , you can use a Bonus Action to attack with the butt of your weapon.
benefits: When attacking with a Glaive , Halberd , Pike , Quarterstaff , or Spear , you can use a Bonus Action to attack with the butt of your weapon.

resilient.name: Resilient
resilient.description:
You increase an Ability by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Gain Proficiency in that ability's Saving throws .
The available passive features are: Resilient: Strength
Resilient: Dexterity
Resilient: Constitution
Resilient: Intelligence
Resilient: Wisdom

ritual_caster.description: You learn two Ritual spells of your choice.
benefits: You learn two Ritual spells of your choice.

savage_attacker.name: Savage Attacker
savage_attacker.description: When making melee weapon attacks, you roll your damage dice twice and use the highest result.
benefits: When making melee weapon attacks, you roll your damage dice twice and use the highest result.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.description: When an enemy in melee range attacks an ally, you can use a Reaction to make a weapon attack against that enemy. Target ally must not have the Sentinel feat.
benefits: When an enemy in melee range attacks an ally, you can use a Reaction to make a weapon attack against that enemy. Target ally must not have the Sentinel feat.

benefits: Your ranged weapon attacks are not penalized for High Ground Rules .

benefits: Gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throw when wielding a Shield .

benefits: You gain Proficiency in 3 Skills of your choice.

spell_sniper.name: Spell Sniper
spell_sniper.description: You learn a cantrip, and the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking with a Spell is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.
benefits: You learn a cantrip, and the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking with a Spell is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.
